title: Supporting Growler Airborne Facilities in Amberley, Queensland
summary: RPS, A Tetra Tech Company provided project management and contract administration for Defense facilities supporting Royal Australian Air Force Growler operations.
body_markdown:
RPS, A Tetra Tech Company provided project management and contract administration for Defense facilities supporting Royal Australian Air Force Growler operations.


## Challenge


The Department of Defence required new facilities at Royal Australian Air Force Base Amberley in Queensland to support operation and maintenance of its Boeing EA-18G Growler aircraft.


The project was initiated to deliver new administrative, operations and training spaces at the base to support Growler aircraft operations by the Royal Australian Air Force’s No. 6 Squadron.


With several other major upgrade initiatives taking place at Royal Australian Air Force Base Amberley at the same time, communication with stakeholders was vital to prevent disruption to operational capability at the base. The project also involved more than 100 stakeholders, creating a need for clear communication, disciplined project management and strong contract administration.

## Benefits


- Supported Royal Australian Air Force Growler operations

- Helped prevent disruption to operational capability

The project received the 2018 Australian Institute of Project Management Queensland Regional Project of the Year award and the 2018 Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors Project Management & Building Consultancy Team Award.
